cases.problem: Analyze this dataset and give the company the best plan.
Build a mathematical model for the future of this business.
Use a neural network to forecast next week's store demand from the historical daily sales time series. Validation must preserve chronological order and predict future dates.
Forecast electricity load for each of the next 12 months from historical monthly observations, using rolling-origin validation.
Predict future ICU admissions over the next 14 days from historical admission counts; time order matters.
Given a directed capacitated network with source s and sink t, compute the maximum s-t flow and verify it with the minimum cut.
Find the shortest path from a source node to a destination in a weighted directed road network where graph topology is the core object.
Find a maximum bipartite matching between workers and tasks in a graph of compatibility edges.

First forecast next quarter's product demand from historical time series with chronological validation. Then use those forecasts to choose production quantities under capacity constraints to maximize profit.
Forecast future traffic demand on a road network, then compute maximum flow routing on that network under capacities.

Simulate a stochastic service system under multiple replications to estimate waiting-time distributions, then choose the number of servers to minimize cost subject to a waiting-time service constraint.
Select a portfolio of assets to maximize expected return and minimize risk. No weights or preference between the two objectives are given; keep both as trade-offs.
Choose facility locations to maximize population coverage and minimize construction cost. No preference weights are given; both objectives must be traded off.
Select suppliers to maximize quality score and minimize expected delay, with a procurement budget constraint. No preference between quality and delay is provided.
Select production quantities for products subject to machine-hour and material constraints to maximize total profit. One objective.
Choose a subset of projects with costs under a budget to maximize total expected profit. Single-objective 0/1 knapsack.
Assign nurses to shifts under labor rules and demand coverage to minimize total staffing cost. One objective and hard constraints.

A real-estate dataset contains current property features (area, rooms, age, location) and historical sale prices. Build a model to predict the sale price of a property from its current features. Evaluate with RMSE, MAE, and R-squared. There is no future-time forecasting requirement.
Using current account attributes (tenure, monthly charges, contract type), predict whether a customer will churn. Report accuracy, precision, recall, and F1.
Historical simulation data contain sensor readings and failure labels. Predict the probability that a machine will fail from its current readings; this is not a stochastic process simulation.

Model a single-server queue with random Poisson arrivals and random service times. Run multiple independent replications with warm-up and measure steady-state waiting time and queue length distributions.
Simulate a stochastic inventory system with random daily demand and lead times over many independent replications; report the distribution of stockouts and average inventory.
Build a discrete-event simulation of a bank teller system with random arrivals and service, including warm-up and confidence intervals over replications.
Design and train a deep reinforcement learning policy for autonomous robot locomotion from raw pixels, including policy optimization and exploration.
